result.title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
result.summary: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. Each run fits one linear readout on the parent's steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. Huxley-Gödel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. The tables report the held-out score of that node on the other 100 HumanEval+ instances and the other 145 Polyglot instances, next to the root scaffold and the calibration edit with the highest fit-split label. Twelve runs of GPT-4o return a node at 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, against 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation. On that split Huxley-Gödel Machine selection returns 85.1%, the root is at 81.2%, and the calibration-best edit is at 82.8%. On the same split Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns 86.6%, beside 86.5% for Huxley-Gödel Machine selection, 85.3% for the parent-rate ablation, and 85.1% for the calibration-best edit.

AI.brief_summary: 研究在有限预算下让编码代理自改脚手架时，用父节点 steering 划分解率与提案 diff 的八个坐标拟合线性读出，在候选编辑运行前为其打分，并在 HumanEval+ 与 Polyglot 上比较多种选择与返回规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「运行前用廉价线性打分挑选候选、配合预算化搜索与存档并按早期评估结果确定返回节点」的做法，可能为 LVR 中在生成前筛选候选推理轨迹、分配计算与停止决策提供线索，但该方法面向纯代码代理、无多模态或 latent 状态实验，可供核查。
